publicReleaseNotes: MAIL_RECIPIENTS=owner, a public deploy input: every email the installation sends goes to OWNER_EMAIL alone and any other address is refused before the provider is called, so alerts reach the owner's verified address. Default any is unchanged. See Send alerts to the owner only. An owner can add an email alert destination for their own sign-in address without enrolling a second factor, so a new installation can alert its owner with nothing to set up first. Alerts to it give nobody new access; any other address, webhook or Slack URL still asks for a second factor verified in the last five minutes. Changing an alert destination's email address or URL now asks for a second factor verified in the last five minutes, like creating one. Renaming, enabling or disabling a destination does not. An upgrade from 0.5.30 applies no database migrations and writes zero D1 rows for migrations. The latest migration remains 0097_bound_notification_reads.sql. The @runeditrun/rer pin stays at 0.2.131. The backup and upgrade guidance under 0.5.26 still applies. Existing installations keep MAIL_RECIPIENTS=any unless you set the input at deploy.
